title: Deploying AI in Healthcare

reader_summary.headline: We live in a world where the demand for health care is just rising so quickly.
reader_summary.overview: We live in a world where the demand for health care is just rising so quickly. We have 10,000 people aging in the Medicare every single day. And we just can't train doctors fast enough to take care of all these people.

key_points.text: The practice surface area for the clinician will look fundamentally different in the next three to five years.
key_points.evidence_quote: The practice surface area for the clinician will look fundamentally different in the next three to five years.

key_points.text: When I was deploying my own software back in the day, doctors would grow and they'd be like, oh.
key_points.evidence_quote: When I was deploying my own software back in the day, doctors would grow and they'd be like, oh, yet another tool like why are you stuffing this down my throat?

key_points.text: The delta between the magic of the tool that they're experiencing and their consumer lives and what they do in their work has for the first time.
key_points.evidence_quote: The delta between the magic of the tool that they're experiencing and their consumer lives and what they do in their work has for the first time, narrowed.

key_points.text: Just even a little bit to a point where it's just fundamentally changed the nature of how they view technology.
key_points.evidence_quote: Just even a little bit to a point where it's just fundamentally changed the nature of how they view technology.

thesis: The speakers argue that the convergence of AI scaling laws and the unique experience of running a medical practice has created a pathway for clinicians to do more with less while improving the patient experience. They explain that Ambience was founded by dropping out of an MD/PhD program to build a full-stack care delivery asset first, which allowed them to apply early transformer models to proprietary claims data and understand the specific challenges of implementing technology in clinical settings.
